title: Shared Bucket-List Progress
dataSources: Relationship check-ins (`relationship:checkin`), date nights (`datenight:log`), gift ideas (`giftidea:item`), keep-in-touch contacts (`keptintouch:contact`).
app: Relationship and togetherness logs — shared check-in apps, date-night and gift-idea lists, and stay-in-touch reminders — sent to Splunk HEC via scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=giftidea:item category=bucketlist
| stats sum(eval(if(status="done",1,0))) as done, count as total
| eval pct=round(100*done/total,1)
description: Tracks how many items on your shared bucket list you have actually done together, keeping big dreams moving.
value: A visible bucket-list bar turns someday plans into things you actively work toward as a couple or family.
implementation: Log bucket-list items and completions into `index=personal`; review overall progress.
visualization: Progress bar of shared bucket-list completion.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks how many things on your shared bucket list you have done together, keeping your dreams alive.
